h1: CKPC Properties New Launch on Hosur Road: Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru

blocks.text: CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd., one of Bengaluru’s most respected commercial real estate developers, has launched its flagship residential project on Hosur Main Road. Heart of Harmony is a 24-floor, single-tower development at Kudlu Gate — 137 luxury 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residences with just 6 homes per floor, a vehicle-free podium, and Kudlu Gate Metro Station at 400 metres. It is the only new launch of its kind in the Kudlu Gate corridor in 2026.

This page covers everything buyers and investors need to know about this new launch — the project details, what CKPC Properties brings to the table, the configurations and confirmed carpet areas, RERA compliance, and how to register interest.

blocks.text: Why CKPC Properties Chose Hosur Road for Its Flagship Residential Launch

CKPC Properties has been active on Hosur Road’s commercial belt for years — 360° Business Park in Electronic City is a defining development on this corridor, and the TCS lease that covers 1.4 million sq ft over 15 years is one of Bengaluru’s largest office transactions. The developer knows this corridor in a way that a purely residential developer entering the market cannot.
The decision to launch Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road reflects three specific observations about this micro-market in 2026:

items: Structural demand from Electronic City: 200,000+ tech professionals work in Electronic City, 4–6 km south of Kudlu Gate. Senior professionals in this workforce consistently seek quality housing within a short commute of their workplace. The supply of genuine luxury residential product — not mid-segment apartments marketed as luxury — to serve this demand is thin.

Metro as a permanent value driver: The Yellow Line (RV Road to Bommasandra) made Kudlu Gate a metro station. At 400 metres from the site, this is not just a lifestyle feature — it is a structural appreciation driver that compounds over time as metro ridership and property values around Yellow Line stations continue to rise.

A gap in the luxury market: Most new launches in the 560068 pin code are 8–14 homes per floor, mid-segment projects. CKPC saw an opportunity to build something genuinely different — a boutique 137-home tower with 6 homes per floor, where the developer’s commercial discipline around quality and delivery is applied to the residential product for the first time.

blocks.text: What Makes This New Launch Different from Every Other Project on Hosur Road

The luxury residential market on Hosur Road is competitive but not deeply differentiated. Most projects offer broadly similar products — a tower of 300–500 apartments with a ground-level clubhouse, standard 8–10 homes per floor, and amenities shared by a large population. Heart of Harmony departs from this in ways that are structural, not cosmetic.

items: 6 homes per floor across 24 floors: The single most important specification. It means every apartment has three open sides — zero common walls — which delivers 270° panoramic views, natural cross-ventilation, genuine acoustic privacy, and a lift lobby shared with 5 families instead of 15.

Vehicle-free podium: All parking is in two basement levels. The ground-level podium is entirely car-free — residents step out of the lobby into landscaped greenery. This is a planning decision that creates 84% open green space on the site, a figure most projects in this price range cannot match.

Rooftop clubhouse at 24 floors: The pool, gym, spa, and indoor amenities are at the top of the tower with panoramic skyline views — not at ground level. The experience of using these facilities is fundamentally different when you are above the city rather than beside the car park.

137 total homes: A boutique scale that keeps the community selective, the facilities uncrowded, and the building maintained to a standard that large-scale projects find difficult to sustain over time.

The Configurations: 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK Sky Residences
Heart of Harmony offers four configurations across its 24 residential floors, each with RERA-confirmed carpet areas and zero common walls.

All four configurations share the same defining features: zero common walls, three-sided openings for 270° panoramic views, 9.5–10 foot ceiling height, UPVC double-glazed windows, and access to all 40+ amenities.
For buyers evaluating 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments for sale in Kudlu Gate , Heart of Harmony is the premium end of the available supply in this micro-market.
CKPC Properties: The Developer Behind the New Launch

CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd. is led by Chirag Purushotam as Managing Director and CEO. The company has delivered over 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces in Bengaluru — a portfolio that includes Fortune 100 tenants such as TCS, Siemens, Bosch, Merck, Continental, and Rockwell Automation. The 1.4 million sq ft TCS lease at 360° Business Park in Electronic City is among the largest office transactions in Bengaluru’s recent history. For a full read on the developer’s track record, see the CKPC Properties developer profile .

Heart of Harmony is CKPC Properties’ first large-scale luxury residential launch. The same execution standards — structural quality, timeline discipline, and attention to occupant experience — that earned the trust of Fortune 100 commercial tenants are being applied to this residential project. This is not a developer entering real estate for the first time; it is a developer applying 8 million sq ft of delivery experience to a 137-home residential project.
RERA Compliance and Construction Timeline

Heart of Harmony is fully registered with Karnataka RERA — registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 . Under RERA, the following are legally mandated and verifiable on the Karnataka RERA portal:

items: Approved floor plans and master plan — all plans submitted to RERA match what is being built
Confirmed carpet areas for every configuration — the figures quoted are legally binding disclosures, not marketing estimates
Possession date of March 2030 — registered and enforceable, not a projected timeline
Quarterly construction progress reporting — buyers can track milestone completion on the RERA portal at any time
Financial disclosures — escrow account compliance per RERA requirements

blocks.text: For buyers evaluating this new launch as a Construction-Linked Plan investment, the RERA framework means every payment is tied to a verified construction milestone. Your money moves when the building progresses — not before.

For a complete understanding of what RERA compliance means for buyers of this new launch, read the CKPC Heart of Harmony review which covers the compliance framework in detail alongside an honest buyer’s analysis.
Who This New Launch is Built For
Heart of Harmony is a specific product for a specific buyer. It is not the right choice for everyone, and being clear about this saves time for buyers on both sides of that line.

items: Electronic City professionals, 32–50, family of three to five, earning well, who want to stop compromising on home quality and want a metro-accessible address that eliminates commute dependency.
Senior managers and C-suite executives from the Silk Board and HSR Layout employment belt who want the highest-specification 3.5 BHK or 4 BHK available in South Bengaluru.
NRI buyers from the Bengaluru tech diaspora seeking a RERA-protected investment with strong rental yield potential and a credible developer — not a first-time developer making promises.
Real estate investors who understand that boutique luxury with metro access and scarce supply is the profile that delivers superior long-term returns compared to large-scale township developments.

blocks.text: It is not built for buyers who need to move in immediately, who want the lowest per-sq-ft price in the corridor, or who prefer the established social infrastructure of HSR Layout or Koramangala as a primary address.
How to Register Interest in This New Launch
Heart of Harmony is an active launch with units available across all four configurations. The process to evaluate and book is straightforward.

items: Request the cost sheet: Call +91 76499 99586 or email sales@ckpcproperties.com — ask for current pricing, floor-wise availability, and the construction-linked payment schedule.

Download the brochure: The full project brochure with floor plan drawings, confirmed carpet areas, amenity details, and specification sheet is available on request. Request the Heart of Harmony brochure here .
Schedule a site visit: See the actual construction progress, walk the site, and meet the CKPC team. Book a site visit here .
Verify the RERA registration: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 at rera.karnataka.gov.in — approved plans, possession date, and financial disclosures are all publicly accessible.
